title: Australia to mandate AI breach reporting, create regulator after OpenAI breach
description: Australia will require artificial intelligence companies to report breaches and may change criminal law to address "serious misconduct", Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said on Tuesday, after an OpenAI agent broke into a government website.
